name: TextBox 6
text:
FoodMind/
 
├─ foodmind-backend/  public API · permissions · business rules · data
│  ├─ src/ … auth · user · catalog · record · group
│  │      search · chat · recommendation · cooking
│  │      analytics · wanttotry · media
│  ├─ resources/db/migration/   (Flyway V1–V12)
│  └─ docs/   (architecture · ERD · api)
 
├─ foodmind-web/  React client (Web)
│  ├─ src/routes/   Home · Chat · Cooking · Analytics
│  │      Record · Inventory · Group · Explore · Recipe
│  └─ src/lib/api/   (generated API client)
 
├─ foodmind-android/  Kotlin/Compose client (Android)
│  └─ app/src/…   Main · Login · Profile · History · Groups
│        Dashboard · Chat · Cooking · Recommendation
 
├─ foodmind-intelligence/  private AI services (LangGraph)
│  └─ agent-service/app/agents/
│     ├─ recommendation/
│     ├─ cooking/
│     └─ chatbot/
 
├─ foodmind-ml/  offline training · model package
│  ├─ scripts/   (train_hybrid_model, …)
│  ├─ src/foodmind_ml/pipeline.py
│  └─ reports/metrics/hybrid_lr_metrics.json
 
├─ foodmind-infra/  Docker · CI/CD · cloud deployment
│  ├─ .github/workflows/   (per-repo CI)
│  ├─ scripts/cd/   (deployment scripts)
│  └─ cloudformation.*.yaml · compose.*.yaml
 
└─ foodmind-docs/  docs · evidence · presentation
   └─ presentation/slides/ · planning/ · testing/ · evidence/
